tools.name: pvault_vault_overview
tools.description: Vault entity_kind, counts, default_vault, registered_vaults, vault_groups.

tools.name: pvault_lookup_accession
tools.description: Lookup records (seq, termini, aligned_span) by accession, stem, prefix, seq_id, seq_hash, or domain_architecture.

tools.name: pvault_query
tools.description: Declarative query over .pvault, UNIONs, GROUP BY cluster, and .p3d structures; mints ResultSetHandleId.

tools.name: pvault_search_homologs
tools.description: 1D sequence or 3Di structural homolog search returning ResultSetHandleId and top hits.

tools.name: pvault_inspect_cluster
tools.description: Cluster conservation, Neff, foldability, 3D hotspots, subclade slicing & ASR.

tools.name: pvault_measure_3d_geometry
tools.description: 3D Ca/Cb distances, lDDT/TM-score, constellation check, or PDB export.

tools.name: pvault_materialize_msa
tools.description: Materialize .a3m MSA or ColabFold multimer .tar.gz bundle.

tools.name: pvault_evaluate_construct
tools.description: Audit monomer/multimer constructs, ΔE fitness, batch ranking, & DMS/epistasis.
